Trusted validation accuracy was 0.7458.", "metric": 0.74581281, "lower_is_better": false, "code_summary": "Schema-driven preprocessing (numeric vs categorical detection, category code mapping fitted on training rows only) is persisted via pickle. Two gradient-boosting models are blended: LightGBM (with categorical features) and sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier, both trained with multi-seed averaging. Blend weight and decision threshold are selected via 5-fold StratifiedKFold out-of-fold probabilities on training rows only. Predictions are produced by reloading the pickled preprocessor and models, blending class probabilities, and mapping indices back to original labels, output as row_id,prediction."}
